zh: 我最近老是见到他。
en: I have seen much of him lately.

zh: 我在火车上碰到老朋友。
en: I came upon an old friend of mine on the train.

zh: 我们是老朋友了。
en: We're friends from way back.

zh: 她的老朋友来了。
en: She's on the rag.

zh: 快要考期末试了，所以我很忙。
en: I'm busy because the finals are drawing on.

zh: 俊杰今天请假，好像去考公职。
en: Chun-chieh took the day off. I think he's taking the civil service exam.

zh: 令我非常伤心的是她考砸了。
en: She failed the examination and I was greatly disappointed.

zh: 你的考试通过了吗？
en: Did you pass your exams?

zh: 我必须读书准备考试。
en: I have to study for the test.

zh: 他能过考试的，是不是？
en: He could pass the examination, could not he?

zh: 他不但会说普通话，而且会说上海话。
en: Not only can he speak Mandarin, but Shanghainese as well.

zh: 有些事我要跟你说，而且我知道你不会喜欢。
en: There's something I need to tell you, and I know you're not going to like it.

zh: 我们看了这部电影，而且还很喜欢。
en: We saw this movie and we loved it.

zh: 只要没有肉，都可以。
en: As long as there's no meat, anything is fine.

zh: 他给这只狗一些肉。
en: He gives some meat to the dog.

zh: 给这只狗一些肉。
en: Give some meat to the dog.

zh: 为什么小朋友得背这么重的书包呢?
en: Why do children have to carry such a heavy bag?

zh: 请帮我洗背。
en: Please wash my back.

zh: 我的背还在痛。
en: My back still hurts.

zh: 没有她的帮忙我也能做。
en: I can do it without her help.

zh: 没有你的帮忙我也能做。
en: I can do it without your help.

zh: 没有他的帮助我也能做。
en: I can do without his help.

zh: 我也很高兴能够认识你。
en: I'm also very pleased to have seen you.

zh: 我能够教你的就这么多了。
en: There's nothing more I can teach you.

zh: 我很高兴能够认识您。
en: I am glad to make your acquaintance.

zh: 「我的脚没你的脏！」「别说得好像它们算得上干净！」
en: "My feet aren't so dirty as yours!" "You'd be hard-pressed to call them clean, though!"

zh: 在又黑又脏的大厦里，它们就像星星一样地闪耀着。
en: They shone like stars in the dark, dirty building.

zh: 我的胸罩脏了。
en: My bra is dirty.

zh: 孩子们洗了他们的脚。
en: The children washed their feet.

zh: 医生在检查脚。
en: The doctor is examining the foot.

zh: 洗您的脚。
en: Wash your feet.

zh: 洗你的脸和手。
en: Wash your face and hands.

zh: 我不喜欢她的脸。
en: I'm not fond of her face.

zh: 我摑了他的脸。
en: I slapped his face.

zh: 我的腿比你的小。
en: My legs are smaller than yours.

zh: 不要拉我的腿！
en: Don't pull my leg!

zh: 他一直盯着她的腿。
en: He was staring at her legs the whole time.

zh: 我必须靠自己做所有事。
en: I've had to do everything by myself.

zh: 她很清楚自己该怎么做。
en: She knows exactly what she should do.

zh: 你自己做回家作业的吗?
en: Did you do your homework by yourself?

zh: 自由非常非常重要。
en: Freedom is very, very important.

zh: 现在我自由了。
en: Now I am free.

zh: 她会得到自由。
en: She'll be freed.

zh: 在门口的自行车是我的。
en: The bicycle by the door is mine.

zh: 这是我自己的自行车。
en: This is my own bike.

zh: 我骑了我的自行车去商店。
en: I rode my bicycle to the store.

zh: 没吃早饭，我有些不舒服。
en: I don't feel very good when I haven't eaten breakfast.

zh: 我们发现这些床很舒服。
en: We found the beds quite comfortable.

zh: 我觉得有点儿不舒服。
en: I feel sick.

zh: 我的船是小的。
en: My boat is small.

zh: 这是我的船。
en: This is my boat.

zh: 船快要开了。
en: The ship is about to set sail.

zh: 大家都很喜欢这个节日。
en: Everyone likes this festival very much.

zh: 我小时候，最喜欢的节日是圣诞节。
en: Christmas was my favorite holiday when I was a kid.

zh: 我小时候最喜欢的节日是圣诞节。
en: Christmas was my favorite holiday when I was a kid.

zh: 今天电视有什么好节目？
en: Are there any good programs on TV today?

zh: 节目已经完了。
en: The programme is over.

zh: 秋季将有新节目在电视上出现。
en: New programmes will appear in the fall on television.

zh: 我喜欢花时间和Tom在一起。
en: I love spending time with Tom.

zh: 我们在这里花了太多时间。
en: We've spent too much time here.

zh: 我很满意你送我的花。
en: I'm very pleased with the flowers you gave me.

zh: 你在哪儿？ 我在花园中。
en: Where are you? I am in the garden.

zh: 花园在房子对面。
en: The garden is in front of the house.

zh: 他喜欢照顾花园。
en: He likes taking care of the garden.

zh: 请您用中文或英文回答。
en: Please reply in Chinese or English.

zh: 我买了份英文写的报纸。
en: I bought a newspaper written in English.

zh: 我的英文得到了好成绩。
en: I got a good grade in English.

zh: 那是学英语最好的方法。
en: That's the best approach to the study of English.

zh: 是谁教她怎么说英语的？
en: Who taught her how to speak English?

zh: 我听她说英语说得流利。
en: I heard her speak English fluently.

zh: 是你准备好茶的时候了。
en: It's about time you got the tea ready.

zh: 我妈妈很喜欢茶。
en: My mother likes tea very much.

zh: 您想再来点茶吗？
en: Would you like some more tea?

zh: 草为什么是绿色的？
en: Why is grass green?

zh: 我听说英国的草在冬天也还是绿的。
en: I hear the grass in England is green even in the winter.

zh: 这几种动物是吃草的。
en: These animals feed on grass.

zh: 从草地里出来。
en: Stay off the grass.

zh: 不要踩草地。
en: Keep off the grass.

zh: 草地看来不错。
en: The grass looks nice.

zh: 医生给他的病人开了一些药。
en: The physician prescribed his patient some medicine.

zh: 这些是我吃的药。
en: These are the medicines I use.

zh: 医生给您开了药。
en: The doctor has prescribed you medicine.

zh: 最近的药店在哪里？
en: Where's the nearest drugstore?

zh: 你喜欢为家人做什么菜？
en: What's a dish you enjoy for your family?

zh: 早饭的时候你最喜欢什么菜？
en: What's your favorite breakfast food?

zh: 你喜欢吃什么菜？
en: What vegetables do you like to eat?

zh: 你有英语的菜单吗？
en: Do you have a menu in English?

zh: 这是你的菜单。
en: Here is your menu.

zh: 请给我菜单。
en: Please show me the menu.

zh: 你知道为什么天看起来这么蓝吗？
en: Do you know the reason why the sky looks blue?

zh: 天空是多么的蓝啊！
en: How blue the sky is!

zh: 为什么天空是蓝的？
en: Why is the sky blue?

zh: 她最喜欢的颜色是蓝色。
en: Her favorite color is blue.

zh: 你要绿色的还是蓝色的？
en: Do you want the green or the blue?

zh: 蓝色的电话在桌子上。
en: The blue telephone is on the table.

zh: 虽然我没在火车上睡觉。
en: Although I haven't slept on the train.

zh: 虽然时间好早，天气已经热了。
en: Although it was still early, it was already hot outside.

zh: 她虽然可爱，但是我不喜欢她。
en: She may be cute, but I don't like her.

zh: 你从哪儿买的这些蛋？
en: Where did you buy these eggs?

zh: 您要什么样的蛋？
en: How do you like your eggs done?

zh: 这是个蛋。
en: This is an egg.

zh: 行。你住在什么地方？
en: OK, what kind of place do you live at?

zh: 你觉得那样子行吗？
en: You want to leave it like that?

zh: 你忙，我自己干也行。
en: You are busy; I can do it myself.

zh: 您必须为您自己不小心的行为负责。
en: You must take responsibility for your own careless actions.

zh: 一部分人感觉Tom的行为举止不太合适。
en: Some people felt that Tom's behavior was inappropriate.

zh: 她为自己孩子的行为感到羞耻。
en: She was ashamed of her children's behavior.

zh: 我的母亲经常让行人吃耳光。
en: My mother often slaps passers-by.

zh: 现在是行动的时候了。
en: Now is the time for action.

zh: 时间不多，我们必须马上行动。
en: Time is short, we must act NOW.

zh: 您必须马上行动。
en: It is imperative for you to act at once.

zh: 我的房子就在对街。
en: My house is just across the street.

zh: 他的房子在街对面。
en: His house is across the street.

zh: 他住在我们街对面。
en: He lives across the street from us.

zh: 这些书和衣服都是你的。
en: These books and clothes are all yours.

zh: 我穿好衣服，然后吃早饭。
en: I'm getting dressed, after which I will take my breakfast.

zh: 穿上衣服，然后跟我们来！
en: Put on clothes and come with us!

zh: 这是我昨天买的表。
en: This is the watch I bought yesterday.

zh: 他偷了我的表。
en: He stole my watch.

zh: 他看了一眼他的表。
en: He glanced at his watch.

zh: 你在你的车上装雪地轮了吗？
en: Have you put winter tyres on your car yet?

zh: 我要求南西留在家里。
en: I asked Nancy to stay at home.

zh: 我听说南西很漂亮。
en: I hear that Nancy is very pretty.

zh: 太阳在东方升起，西方落下。
en: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

zh: 因为中国是个发展中的国家，所以有的方面没有西方国家那么好。
en: Because it's a developing country, some aspects of China aren't as good as those in Western countries.

zh: 不过，其它的方面已经超过了很多西方国家的程度。
en: However, other aspects have already surpassed the standards of many Western countries.

zh: 太阳在西边落下。
en: The sun sets in the west.

zh: 太阳在西边落下
en: The sun sets in the west.

zh: 太阳在西边下山。
en: The sun sets in the west.

zh: 直接和我说我要做什么。
en: Just tell me what I have to do.

zh: 明天，一定要给我打电话。
en: Mind you call me up tomorrow.

zh: 明天有许多要干的事情。
en: I have a lot of work to do tomorrow.

zh: 我要求你们现在就走。
en: I want you to leave now.

zh: 我要求他明天去那里。
en: I asked him to go there tomorrow.

zh: 他们要求我更努力地工作。
en: They require me to work harder.

zh: 我在机场见了个朋友。
en: I met a friend at the airport.

zh: 我不知道谁会在机场见我。
en: I didn't know who was going to meet me at the airport.

zh: 你想什么时候见他们？
en: When do you want to meet them?

zh: 你可能能在那里见到我。
en: You might see me there.

zh: 我已经好久没有见到你了。
en: I haven't seen you in ages.

zh: 我们有时会见到他们。
en: We sometimes meet them.

zh: 我以前在这里没见过你。
en: I haven't seen you around here before.

zh: 我记得我在哪儿见过你。
en: I remember having seen you somewhere before.

zh: 我记得好像在哪里见过她。
en: I remember having seen her somewhere.

zh: 我们会在我的办公室见面。
en: We'll meet in my office.

zh: 谢谢你来跟我见面。
en: Thank you for coming to meet me.

zh: 让我们明天再在这里见面吧。
en: Let's meet here again tomorrow.

zh: 你为什么问我的观点？
en: Why are you asking my opinion?

zh: 你的观点是重要的。
en: Your opinion matters.

zh: 这完全是两个不同的观点。
en: Those two ideas are quite distinct.

zh: 我觉得我们应该一起去。
en: I think we should all go together.

zh: 我觉得你应该去看医生。
en: I think you should see a doctor.

zh: 我觉得我们可以做朋友。
en: I think we can be friends.

zh: 这张桌子缺了个角。
en: This table is missing a leg.

zh: 以我的角度来看，他是对的。
en: The way I see it, he is right.

zh: 我们应该用各种不同的角度看待此问题
en: We should approach this problem from different angles.

zh: 你的计划听起来很不错。
en: Your plan sounds great.

zh: 我的计划和你的不同。
en: My plan is different from yours.

zh: 你周末有什么计划？
en: What are your weekend plans?

zh: 您会使用计算机吗？
en: Do you know how to use a computer?

zh: 你永远也成为不了计算机科学家。
en: You will never become a computer scientist.

zh: 我的一些同学真是菜鸟，他们一点都不懂计算机。
en: Some of my classmates are pure noobs; they know nothing about computing sciences.

zh: 我不认为我真的有问题。
en: I don't think I really have a problem.

zh: 我认为我知道是谁做的。
en: I think I know who did it.

zh: 我不认为这是你的座位。
en: I didn't think this was your seat.

zh: 她的弟弟学习很认真。
en: Her brother takes studying very seriously.

zh: 她的哥哥学习很认真。
en: Her brother takes studying very seriously.

zh: 他的弟弟学习很认真。
en: His little brother studies seriously.

zh: 照片里的人我都不认识。
en: I didn't recognize anyone in the photo.

zh: 我也很高兴能够认识你。
en: I'm also very pleased to have seen you.

zh: 你认识照片里的男人吗？
en: Do you know this man in the picture?

zh: 我想和你讨论一些事情。
en: I'd like to discuss something with you.

zh: 我们经常用英语讨论。
en: We usually talked in English.

zh: 我们来讨论下明天吧。
en: Let's talk about this tomorrow.

zh: 有什么你想让我买的吗？
en: Is there anything you want me to buy?

zh: 我说的话让你生气了吗？
en: Are you angry at what I said?

zh: 我想让你离开我的房间。
en: I want you out of my room.

zh: 我开始记起来了。
en: I am beginning to remember it.

zh: 你记事情的能力并不比我好多少。
en: You are no better at remembering things than I am.

zh: 请记住他说的话。
en: Please remember what he said.

zh: 给我记住。
en: Remember that.

zh: 怎么才能记住这些汉字呢？
en: What can I do to remember all these Chinese characters?

zh: 我记得我在哪儿见过你。
en: I remember having seen you somewhere before.

zh: 我不记得有打电话给你。
en: I don't remember calling you.

zh: 我不记得怎么去那里了。
en: I can't remember how to go there.

zh: 许多国家的人讲英文。
en: English is spoken in many countries.

zh: 我不明白他在讲什么。
en: I don't understand what he's saying.

zh: 对不起。你会讲英语吗？
en: Excuse me. Do you speak English?

zh: 上课中不要跟别人讲话。
en: Don't talk to others during the class.

zh: 我不喜欢他讲话的样子。
en: I don't like the way he talks.

zh: 不要这样对我讲话。
en: Don't talk to me like this.

zh: 许多学生喜欢在早上学习。
en: Many students like to study in the morning.

zh: 明天有许多要干的事情。
en: I have a lot of work to do tomorrow.

zh: 许多国家的人说英语。
en: English is spoken in many countries.

zh: 老师说明了词的意思。
en: The teacher explained the meaning of the word to us.

zh: 在我的笔记本里早就有这个词了。
en: This word has been in my notebook for a long time.

zh: 我不知道这个词什么意思。
en: I don't know what this word means.

zh: 你可以随时用我的词典。
en: You may always use my dictionary.

zh: 他说的词典图书馆没有.
en: The dictionary he talked about isn't available in the library.

zh: 我有和你哥哥一样的词典。
en: I have the same dictionary as your brother has.

zh: 快要考期末试了，所以我很忙。
en: I'm busy because the finals are drawing on.

zh: 我今天要参加入学试。
en: I have to take the entrance examination today.

zh: 我已经试过那个了。
en: I've already tried that.

zh: 你怎么什么话也没说？
en: How come you didn't say anything?

zh: 我还有话要对您说。
en: I still need to talk to you.

zh: 他和以前一样话多。
en: He is as talkative as ever.

zh: 那时我不知道该怎么办。
en: I didn't know what to do then.

zh: 请告诉我什么时候该走。
en: Please tell me when to go.

zh: 有点儿晚了，我们该走了。
en: It's getting late, so we'd better get going.

zh: 在Tatoeba，所有语言都是平等的。
en: On Tatoeba, all languages are equal.

zh: 在您的国家说什么语言？
en: What languages are spoken in your country?

zh: 您用您的语言怎么说？
en: How do you say that in your language?

zh: 老师说：“咱们现在就出发。”
en: The teacher said: "Let's set off right now."

zh: 说实在的，我真的喜欢你。
en: Honestly, I really like you.

zh: 直接和我说我要做什么。
en: Just tell me what I have to do.

zh: 老师说明了词的意思。
en: The teacher explained the meaning of the word to us.

zh: 让我给你说明。
en: Let me explain it to you.

zh: 你不用说明的。
en: You didn't need to explain.

zh: 我没时间再跟你说话了。
en: I have no more time to talk with you.

zh: 刚才和你说话的人是谁？
en: Who is the man that you were talking with?

zh: 我不喜欢她说话的态度。
en: I don't like the way she speaks.

zh: 请告诉我什么时候该走。
en: Please tell me when to go.

zh: 请您用中文或英文回答。
en: Please reply in Chinese or English.

zh: 请给我一些热的东西喝。
en: Please give me something hot to drink.

zh: 我不知道他请假的原因。
en: I don't know the reason why he was absent.

zh: 我下周必须请假。
en: I have to be absent from school next week.

zh: 他刚请假走了。
en: He's just gone on leave.

zh: 请坐这里。
en: Please sit in here.

zh: 今天是我请客。
en: Today is my treat.

zh: 晚饭我请客。
en: I'll treat you to dinner.

zh: 今天我来请客。
en: It's my treat today.

zh: 他没有提到她的请求。
en: He made no mention of her request.

zh: 接受他的请求。
en: Accept his request.

zh: 你应该请求你的老师允许。
en: You ought to ask for your teacher's permission.

zh: 不好意思，请问你有笔吗？
en: Excuse me, do you have a pen?

zh: 请问，出租车站在哪里？
en: Excuse me, where is the taxi stand?

zh: 请问鸡蛋要什么做法？
en: How would you like your eggs?

zh: 我还没有读今天的报纸。
en: I haven't read today's newspaper yet.

zh: 我小时候读了她所有的书。
en: When I was small, I read all of her books.

zh: 我今天早上读了一会儿书。
en: I studied for a while this morning.

zh: 为什么您想到外国读书？
en: Why do you want to study abroad?

zh: 为什么你想到外国读书？
en: Why do you want to study abroad?

zh: 我打算今天晚上读书。
en: I'm planning to study tonight.

zh: 晚上 你 还有 课 吗?
en: Do you have lessons at night?

zh: 我去上汉语课。
en: I am going to have a Chinese lesson.

zh: 课开始了，请大家坐好。
en: The class has started. Please take your seats.

zh: 课堂上所有的男生都很用功。
en: All the boys in class worked hard.

zh: 学生在课堂上必须保持安静。
en: Students must keep silent during class.

zh: 我刚跟你的法语老师谈过话，他说你在课堂上表现得很好。
en: I've just spoken to your French teacher and he says you're doing well in his class.

zh: 我们已经有那篇课文了吗？
en: Do we already have that text?

zh: 请你读一下课文。
en: Please read the passage.

zh: 请告诉我你把你的旧课本给谁了。
en: Please tell me who you gave your old textbook to.

zh: 汤姆告诉我他丢了课本。
en: Tom told me that he had lost his textbook.

zh: 这本课本很好。
en: This is a good textbook.

zh: 我知道谁住在这房子里。
en: I know who lives in this house.

zh: 是谁教她怎么说英语的？
en: Who taught her how to speak English?

zh: 我认为我知道是谁做的。

zh: 在门口的自行车是我的。
en: The bicycle by the door is mine.

zh: 车在门口等着。
en: The car is waiting at the gate.

zh: 他站在了门口。
en: He was standing at the door.

zh: 我在哪里可以买到门票？
en: Where can I buy an entrance ticket?

zh: 你怎么拿到车展的免费门票的?
en: How did you get the free ticket for the car show?

zh: 汤姆的门票在哪儿呀？
en: Where's Tom's ticket?

zh: 有不懂的东西就去问吧。
en: If there's anything you don't understand, then go ask about it.

zh: 你问她了吗？她说了什么？
en: You asked about her? What did she say?

zh: 问她什么时候会回来。
en: Ask her when she'll be back.

zh: 有个女人向我问路。
en: A woman asked me for directions.

zh: 我可以问你一些问题吗？
en: May I ask you some more questions?

zh: 我不认为我真的有问题。
en: I don't think I really have a problem.

zh: 他们有他们自己的问题。
en: They have their own troubles.

zh: 这间动物园多久了？
en: How old is this zoo?

zh: 你身体一直非常好，怎么突然间住医院了？
en: Your body was always very healthy; why are you suddenly in the hospital?

zh: 这间酒店的交通位置很方便。
en: This hotel is conveniently located in terms of public transportation.

zh: 麝香的味道是最好闻的味道之一。
en: Musk is one of the best scents.

zh: 他们队又输了。
en: Their team lost again.

zh: 我们队0:2输了。
en: Our team lost, 2-0.

zh: 我们队从来就没赢过。
en: My team is always losing.

zh: 我们选她为我们队的队长。
en: We elected her captain of our team.

zh: 他们让我当了队长。
en: They made me captain.

zh: 我们要你做队长。
en: We want you to be the team captain.

zh: 今天是个阴天。
en: Today is a cloudy day.

zh: 昨天东京是阴天吗?
en: Was it cloudy in Tokyo yesterday?

zh: 明天不是阴天。
en: Tomorrow will not be cloudy.

zh: 我在医院住了一周。
en: I was in hospital for a week.

zh: 你院子里有桌子吗?
en: Do you have a table on the patio?

zh: 他在院子里等我。
en: He is waiting for me in the yard.

zh: 正在下雨，孩子们没有在院子里玩儿。
en: It's raining, so the kids aren't playing in the yard.

zh: 喜欢什么就随便吃吧。
en: Help yourself to anything you like.

zh: 你可以随便用我的车。
en: My car is at your disposal.

zh: 您可以随便去哪儿。
en: You may go anywhere.

zh: 你可以随时用我的词典。
en: You may always use my dictionary.

zh: 请随时都可以打电话给我。
en: Please feel free to call me up.

zh: 你随时可以回家。
en: You are free to go home.

zh: 汉语学起来没那么难。
en: Chinese is not too difficult to learn.

zh: 我很难找到他的房子。
en: I had some trouble in finding his house.

zh: 他很难写他的名字。
en: He can scarcely write his name.

zh: 面包吃多了会难受的。
en: Too much bread makes you sick.

zh: 我生病了，很难受！
en: I'm sick, and it's miserable!

zh: 他死了我真难受。
en: I am very sad that he has died.

zh: 她写的字很难看。
en: She's got terrible handwriting.

zh: 难看得很。
en: It's extremely ugly.

zh: 我的房子又旧又难看。
en: My house is old and ugly.

zh: 我们非常难过的时候就会哭。
en: When we are very sad, we will cry.

zh: 为什么你要这么难过?
en: Why should you be so sad?

zh: 我知道你难过。
en: I know you're upset.

zh: 我问了她一个难题。
en: I asked her a difficult question.

zh: 他解决了难题。
en: He solved the difficult problem.

zh: 雨从早上一直下到现在。
en: It's been raining since morning.

zh: 昨天下了雨，还下了雪。
en: It rained and even snowed yesterday.

zh: 在雨中走出去是不可能的。
en: Going out in this rain is out of the question.

zh: 今年的雪下得比去年多。
en: It snowed more this year than last.

zh: 去年冬天下了好多雪。
en: There was a lot of snow last winter.

zh: 昨天下了雨，还下了雪。
en: It rained and even snowed yesterday.

zh: 这是零的意思。
en: This means nil.

zh: 今天早上温度降到了零下。
en: The temperature has fallen below zero this morning.

zh: 现在是零下十度。
en: It is ten degrees below zero now.

zh: 汤姆是个普通的青少年。
en: Tom is a normal teenager.

zh: 他是个有为的青年。
en: He is a promising youth.

zh: 她是文艺青年。
en: She is a young artist.

zh: 网球在学生中非常流行。
en: Tennis is very popular among students.

zh: 我们学校离公园非常近。
en: Our school is very close to the park.

zh: 她年轻的时候非常漂亮。
en: She was very beautiful in her youth.

zh: 我必须靠自己做所有事。
en: I've had to do everything by myself.

zh: 许多事情靠的是结果。
en: Much depends upon the result.

zh: 靠！我电脑坏了！
en: Aaah!! My computer is broken!

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们就待在家里面。
en: We are staying at home because it's raining.

zh: 我跑着从他们面前经过。
en: I went running past them.

zh: 在你面前是什么东西？
en: What's in front of you?

zh: 别在我面前再提了！
en: Don't ever say this in my presence again!

zh: 面包吃多了会难受的。
en: Too much bread makes you sick.

zh: 我们买了面包和牛奶。
en: We bought bread and milk.

zh: 我非常喜欢吃面包。
en: I love bread.

zh: 我的鞋比你的大。
en: My shoes are bigger than yours.

zh: 这些鞋是她的。
en: These shoes are hers.

zh: 你的鞋在这儿。
en: Your shoes are here.

zh: 他喜欢运动，也喜欢音乐。
en: He likes sports as well as music.

zh: 我没有你那么喜欢音乐。
en: I am not so fond of music as you are.

zh: 您喜欢什么样的音乐呢？
en: What kind of music do you like?

zh: 我想和你一起去音乐会。
en: I would like to go to the concert with you.

zh: 她在音乐会上玩得很开心。
en: She enjoyed herself at the concert.

zh: 如果你不去音乐会, 我也不去。
en: If you are not going to the concert, then neither am I.

zh: 请看25页的地图。
en: Please look at the map on page 25.

zh: 我不喜欢五百页以上的书。
en: I don't like books with more than five hundred pages.

zh: 打开你的书到第九页。
en: Open your book to page nine.

zh: 得到他的帮助，我的工作现在很顺利。
en: Thanks to his help, my work is going well now.

zh: 一切都还顺利吧？
en: Everything's still going well?

zh: 他好像做甚么事儿都很顺利。
en: Everything seems to go right with him.

zh: 顾客永远是正确的吗？
en: Is the customer always right?

zh: 顾客永远是对的。
en: The customer is always right.

zh: 顾客没来。
en: The customer did not come.

zh: 您的头发是什么颜色的？
en: What color is your hair?

zh: 她最喜欢的颜色是蓝色。
en: Her favorite color is blue.

zh: 你认为她喜欢什么颜色？
en: What color do you think she likes?

zh: 明天会有风。
en: It'll be windy tomorrow.

zh: 是什么风把你吹来了啊？
en: What has brought you here?

zh: 多么强的风啊！
en: What a strong wind!

zh: 所有鸟都会飞吗？
en: Can all birds fly?

zh: 你能教我飞吗?
en: Can you teach me to fly?

zh: 不是所有的鸟都会飞。
en: Not all birds can fly.

zh: 你的飞机什么时候起飞？
en: What time does your plane leave?

zh: 飞机上可以吃东西吗？
en: Can I eat on the plane?

zh: 你的飞机什么时候起飞呢？
en: What time is your plane?

zh: 食物的味道让我饿了。
en: The smell of food made me hungry.

zh: 我们点了太多的食物。
en: We ordered too much food.

zh: 你喜欢什么样的食物？
en: What type of food do you like?

zh: 只要你吃完你的饭就可以跟朋友玩。
en: As long as you finish eating your food, then you can play with your friends.

zh: 我去你那蹭饭吃。
en: I'm going to mooch a meal off you at your place.

zh: 餐厅里的饭很便宜，而且很好吃。
en: The food in the cafeteria is cheap, and it's delicious.

zh: 我们的饭店是最好的。
en: Our restaurant is the best.

zh: 有人看见他和情人在饭店吃饭。
en: She was seen at a restaurant with her lover.

zh: 你知道哪家饭店好吗？
en: Do you know a good restaurant?

zh: 有人看到了她在饭馆跟她爱人在一起。
en: She was seen at a restaurant with her lover.

zh: 他去那个中国饭馆吃饭了。
en: He is going to that Chinese restaurant to eat a meal.

zh: 我是上个星期五跟我女朋友在饭馆吃饭的。
en: It was last Friday that I ate dinner with my girlfriend in a restaurant.

zh: 不，谢谢，我饱了。
en: No more, thank you. I'm full.

zh: 我觉得吃完那块大牛排你就饱了。
en: I thought you'd be full after eating that big steak.

zh: 这饺子是什么馅的啊？
en: What is the filling in these dumplings?

zh: 在中国，提到过年，许多人想到的都是一家围在一起包饺子。
en: If you mention New Year in China, the image that many people will think of is a family gathered around wrapping dumplings together.

zh: 食物的味道让我饿了。
en: The smell of food made me hungry.

zh: 我饿了，去吃午餐吧？
en: I'm hungry. Shall we go have lunch?

zh: 我回到家的时候，感觉非常饿。
en: When I came home, I felt very hungry.

zh: 我的生日马上就要到了。
en: My birthday approaches.

zh: 她马上就会回来看我们。
en: She will come back soon to visit us.

zh: 我必须马上和你说话。
en: I have to speak with you immediately.

zh: 我们看见他正在过马路。。
en: We saw him walking across the street.

zh: 我看孩子们过了马路。
en: I saw the children walk across the street.

zh: 我们看到他过马路。
en: We saw him walk across the street.

zh: 我骑了我的自行车去商店。
en: I rode my bicycle to the store.

zh: 我们都喜欢骑自行车。
en: We all like cycling.

zh: 我骑自行车去工作。
en: I bike to work.

zh: 他走路或者骑车过来。
en: He'll come on foot or by bicycle.

zh: 你会骑车吗？
en: Can you ride a bicycle?

zh: 他可喜欢骑车了。
en: He loves cycling.

zh: 她差不多有我那么高。
en: She is about as tall as me.

zh: 她差不多和你一样高。
en: She's almost the same height as you.

zh: 我儿子现在和我一样高了。
en: My son is now as tall as I am.

zh: 你在高中的时候胖吗？
en: Were you fat when you were in high school?

zh: 你在哪里念高中?
en: Where do you attend high school?

zh: 你要去哪个高中读书？
en: Which high school are you going to study in?

zh: 我很高兴在这里看到你。
en: I am happy to see you here.

zh: 我也很高兴能够认识你。
en: I'm also very pleased to have seen you.

zh: 我高兴你喜欢我的朋友。
en: I'm glad you liked my friends.

zh: 汤姆买了台很高级的相机。
en: Tom bought a very good camera.

zh: 你常常晚餐吃鱼吗？
en: Do you often have fish for dinner?

zh: 当我小的时候，我不能够吃鱼。
en: When I was little, I couldn't eat fish.

zh: 晚餐吃鱼怎么样?
en: What about having fish for dinner?

zh: 谢谢你为我画鸟。
en: Thank you for drawing a bird for me.

zh: 所有鸟都会飞吗？
en: Can all birds fly?

zh: 这只鸟叫作什么?
en: What do you call this bird?

zh: 我经常吃鸡。
en: I often eat chicken.

zh: 我让你买鱼，不是鸡！
en: I asked you to buy fish, not chicken!

zh: 请问鸡蛋要什么做法？
en: How would you like your eggs?

zh: 不好意思，请问鸡蛋在哪儿？
en: Excuse me. Where are the eggs?

zh: 它的大小就像鸡蛋。
en: It's about the size of an egg.

zh: 妈妈给弟弟买了个黄雨伞。
en: My mother bought my brother a yellow umbrella.

zh: 你不喜欢我的黄围巾吗？
en: Don't you like my yellow scarf?

zh: 我们有黄苹果。
en: We have yellow apples.

zh: 红色和黄色和蓝色是颜色。
en: Red, yellow and blue are colors.

zh: 办公室的门是黄色的。
en: The door of the office is yellow.

zh: 所有的球都是黄色的。
en: All of the balls are yellow.

zh: 我们到的时候天已经黑了。
en: By the time we had arrived, it was already dark.

zh: 我起来的时候天还是黑的呢。
en: I got up while it was still dark.

zh: 为什么你这么喜欢黑中国？
en: Why do you like smearing China so much?

zh: 她在黑板上写了什么？
en: What did she write on the blackboard?

zh: 请到黑板这儿来。
en: Please come to the blackboard.

zh: 你看得到黑板吗？
en: Can you see the blackboard?

zh: 你喜欢黑色的猫吗？
en: Do you like black cats?

zh: 哪只狗是黑色的？
en: Which dog is black?

zh: 那是黑色的吗？
en: Is it black?
